title: A Breakdown of 6 Coffee Ads (And Why They Work) - Fresh Cup

facts.fact: William Uckers notes, per the page, that one of the first coffee advertisements was a 1587 manuscript by Abd al-Kadir titled "Argument in Favor of the Legitimate Use of Coffee."
facts.quote: one of the first coffee advertisements was a 1587 manuscript by Abd al-Kadir

facts.fact: Pasqua Rosée printed the first English-language coffee advertisement in a handbill for the coffee house he owned in London, according to the page.
facts.quote: In 1652, Pasqua Rosée printed the first English-language coffee advertisement in a handbill

facts.fact: The page shows a vintage sign for Freihofer Baking Company's ground coffee delivery service dating from the 1930s.
facts.quote: Take this vintage sign for Freihofer Baking Company’s ground coffee delivery service from the 1930s

facts.fact: Nguyen Coffee Supply's ad link copy reads "Sold Out 4X Already!", which the page says creates urgency by signaling the coffee has sold out several times.
Partners Coffee offers newsletter subscribers a 10% off coupon in addition to free brewing resources and support from coffee experts.
facts.quote: They’ve also added a 10% off coupon to sweeten the deal.
